COLOR MAPS, BLANK MAPS AND B&W MAPSThis educational resource includes full-color maps, black-and-white maps, and blank maps, all designed to make learning U.S. geography engaging and effective. It offers various options to suit your needs, whether you're focusing on the five regions of the United States, individual states, or a combination of both.Additionally, the blank maps come with activities like coloring and labeling the names of the states, allowing students to actively participate and reinforce their learning.This pack includes:- Color map of U.S. regions.- Color map with U.S. regions clearly separated.- Color map with regions and labeled states.- Color map with clearly separated regions and labeled states.- Black-and-white map with labeled regions and states.- Black-and-white map of regions only.- Blank map of the United States.- Black-and-white map of the states only.- Black-and-white map with numbered states and a corresponding state list.- Blank map with numbered states and a blank list for students to complete.
